profile.summary: Black Rose Industries Limited engages in the import, distribution, and export of specialty and performance chemicals in India and internationally. The company distributes a range of specialty chemicals comprising 8-hydroxyquinoline, alpha picoline, aniline, benzylamine, crude BHT, CTPI/PVI, diallylamine, diethanolamine, ethyl cyanoacetate, gamma picoline, homopiperazine, hydroquinone, meta-aminoph
